steps.text: Morning ❤️ Did you beat that level, or is the controller still the problem?
Finally beat it. Turns out I needed to stop rushing
So the controller made a miraculous recovery 😭
I'd rather not discuss that part
Very convenient 😌 Did you get some sleep afterwards?
Yeah. What about you?
Slept okay, and I got up when the alarm rang for once
A successful morning for both of us
Let's not get carried away, I haven't left the house yet
What are you doing later?
I've got a parcel to collect, then not much
Anything exciting in it?
A phone charger
Try to contain yourself when you open it 😭
I'll save the wrapping for you
How thoughtful ❤️
Full day for you again?
Classes, then work. I'm going home before dinner tonight
Changing before you go?
Yeah, I don't want to take all my work things with me
Your bag will appreciate a night off
It's earned one 😭
Don't leave your keys in it when you change bags
That does sound like something I'd manage
I haven't even decided what to wear yet
You'll look good either way
Thank you handsome ❤️
I'm ready for this part of the day, at least
See? Looking good already
You're making it difficult to leave my phone alone 😊
I'll let you get going. Hope dinner's nice tonight
Thank you, and sorry if today I can't talk much ❤️
I'll text you when I get there, and when I'm back
It's okay, no rush to reply in between
Okay. Have a good day
You too
Love you, talk later ❤️
Love you too
